name: plan_statistician
deliverable: Odds ratios with confidence intervals for tenure, charges, tickets and contract, from a pre-specified model.

stages.name: dtype and range audit; missingness by outcome
explicit dummy coding with fixed reference levels
logistic regression on the pre-specified predictors

decisions.question: What to do with incomplete rows?
decisions.why: complete-case analysis is biased when missingness depends on the outcome

decisions.question: Which columns enter the model?
decisions.why: only variables measured before the churn event; anything else is leakage

decisions.question: How to encode categoricals?
decisions.why: get_dummies on a numeric-as-text column silently one-hots every value

decisions.question: Check for duplicated customers?
decisions.why: joins to billing tables duplicate rows and shrink standard errors

assumptions: predictors were measured before the outcome
units are consistent within each column
no separation in the categorical levels
one_check: the missingness rate of every column split by churned vs not
retraction_notice: Half the churners were dropped by dropna because their support history had been purged on account closure, so the reported effect of support tickets was in the wrong direction.
